subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in, malls and markets, predicting vocabulary / Predicting the content of a talk (Listening 1.4.1)
outcomes: Predict vocabulary and content before listening
Listen to a tour guide and sort phrases into the correct column

tf.s: Predicting the content of a talk makes it easier to understand.
tf.why: Yes, you are ready for the words you will hear.
Correct, you can discuss the price with the shopkeeper.

tf.s: Souqs usually have multi-level car parks and wide walkways.
tf.why: Those are features of malls; souqs have narrow passages.

tf.s: Shopping malls are best for quick, easy shopping.
tf.why: Yes, the talk says malls make shopping quick and easy.

tf.s: Tourists love the narrow passages with tiny shops in souqs.
tf.why: Right, they also like the friendly shopkeepers.

tf.s: All 14 phrases in the list appear in the talk.
Two of the phrases apply to both malls and markets.
tf.why: Correct, phrases 2 and 4 apply to both.

tf.s: Phrases in the talk come in exactly the same order as the list.
tf.why: The order in the talk is different.

tf.s: 'Window-shopping' means looking at things in shops without buying them.
tf.why: Yes, you just look in the windows.

tf.s: A 'souq' is a modern shopping centre with many floors.
tf.why: A souq is a traditional market.

boxes.why: Souq is the Arabic word for market.
Bargaining is part of shopping in souqs.

boxes.q: What do you find in a mall?
Who gives the talk in Listening 1.4.1?
boxes.why: A tour guide talks about shopping.

boxes.q: Why do we predict before listening?
o: to make the talk easier to understand

boxes.q: How many phrases do not occur in the talk?
boxes.why: Phrases 1, 5, 7 and 11 are not in the talk.
You bargain to get a lower price.

boxes.q: Which place is best for quick, easy shopping?
boxes.why: The talk says malls are quick and easy.

boxes.q: What do tourists love about souqs?
boxes.why: Friendly shopkeepers are part of the charm.
You look at goods but don't buy.

mcq.q: Which features belong to a mall?
o: fashion shops, a multi-level car park and wide walkways
mcq.why: These are typical mall features in the talk.

mcq.q: Which features belong to a souq?
o: bargaining, narrow passages and friendly shopkeepers
escalators and a multi-level car park
a cinema and a food court
mcq.why: These are typical souq features in the talk.

mcq.q: What should you do before listening to a talk?
o: predict its likely content and vocabulary
mcq.why: Predicting prepares you for what you will hear.

mcq.q: According to the guide, what kind of shopping do malls offer?
mcq.why: The guide says malls make shopping quick and easy.

mcq.q: You want to buy a gift and pay a lower price by discussing it with the seller. Where should you go?
You have only 20 minutes to buy everything and need parking. Where is best?
mcq.why: Malls offer quick, easy shopping and big car parks.

mcq.q: You will hear a talk about shopping in Muscat. Which words should you predict?
mcq.why: Predict words that match the topic.

mcq.q: Why does predicting help with listening?
o: you expect the likely content and vocabulary, so the text is easier
mcq.why: Prediction prepares you to recognise words.

mcq.q: Which is one similarity between malls and markets?
o: both sell a great variety of things

mcq.q: Why might someone say both souqs and malls are a shopper's paradise?
o: each offers variety in its own way
mcq.why: Each place has its own attractions.
